about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

An invasion of androids from outer space has reached Earth. Zion and Eerie find themselves surrounded by these strange androids who relentlessly capture humans. Faced with this situation, Zion is forced to use his martial arts skills to fight the enemies. With the help of cosmic armor obtained from one of the invading androids, he will embark on a crusade to save Eerie and the other humans. Immerse yourself in a retro adventure that will transport you back to the golden days of handheld consoles.

Cosmo Knight Zion is a classic platform game, like those that were so popular in the 90s. It offers levels full of excitement, hidden elements, enemies to defeat, beautiful scenes that tell the story of the game, and powerful level bosses that will remind you of the challenging difficulty of yesteryear. Cosmo Knight Zion brings you the full retro experience of handheld consoles.

A RETRO-STYLE JOURNEY

Classic retro-style platform game inspired by the famous handheld consoles of the 90s. Jump, hit, collect items, and get power-ups as you advance through challenging levels and face powerful bosses. The key to success is not giving up and knowing your enemy. Will you make it through with your armor intact?

EXCITING FEATURES

  • In-game manual.

  • Five challenging levels

  • Powerful level bosses

  • Secret bosses

  • Collectible items

  • In-game achievements

  • Story told through Pixel Art vignettes

  • Retro music and graphics with a pixelated style
